description: For recruiters My jobs Sign in Find Jobs Software Developer (GraphQL Focus) Falcorp Resourcing Fairland Fixed Term Full Time Published: 1 week ago Non EE/AA I'm interested Save Software Developer (GraphQL Focus) Falcorp Resourcing I'm interested Introduction The Software Developer (GraphQL Focus) is a domain-specialized software engineer responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing unified GraphQL API layers to streamline data consumption across diverse web and mobile platforms. Operating at the direct intersection of client-side user experience, backend microservices, and enterprise data graph orchestration, this developer acts as a bridge engineer who eliminates data over-fetching/under-fetching and standardizes frontend-to-backend data delivery. The position requires a focused developer with expert knowledge of schema definition languages, resolver execution logic, and graph federations, alongside a deep understanding of frontend state management. Duties & Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain clean, extendable GraphQL schemas, custom types, mutations, subscriptions, and directive definitions across client applications. Write, test, and optimize asynchronous resolver functions that seamlessly bind GraphQL endpoints to underlying microservices, REST APIs, and direct database layers. Implement graph federation solutions (e.g. Apollo Federation) and schema stitching to consolidate disparate backend services into a single, unified data graph. Diagnose and resolve problem and resource exhaustion risks using batching, caching strategies, and tools like DataLoader and Redis. Configure, monitor, and enforce query complexity analysis, depth limiting, and field-level access control to protect the GraphQL engine against denial-of-service threats. Collaborate directly with React, React Native, Angular, and mobile application teams to structure query schemas aligned precisely with client state requirements. Maintain comprehensive schema documentation, interactive playground environments, and developer tooling to simplify frontend team onboarding and adoption. Continuously monitor and profile GraphQL engine operations, tracing query field execution latencies and optimizing payload transport efficiency. Implement client-side and server-side caching policies (Apollo Client / Relay) to minimize redundant network round-trips and optimize offline data handling. Participate actively in agile ceremonies, providing accurate task estimations, schema design reviews, and continuous improvement inputs within Jira. Desired Experience & Qualification National Diploma, Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field. A minimum of 3 to 5 years of commercial software development experience, with at least 2+ years dedicated hands-on experience building production GraphQL layers. Mastery of the modern GraphQL stack, including Apollo Server/Client, GraphQL Java, Hasura, Prisma, or TypeGraphQL, using TypeScript/Node.js or Java. Relevant cloud or developer certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer, Apollo GraphQL Developer Certification) are advantageous. Experience in IT Consulting or Telecommunications domains will be advantageous. In-depth understanding of API paradigms, contrasting GraphQL with REST, gRPC, and SOAP architectures in terms of performance and network overhead. Demonstrated proficiency using DataLoader, Redis, and query caching implementations to eliminate performance bottlenecks in graph traversal. Solid experience integrating GraphQL layers with modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, React Native, or Angular) and state management libraries. Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset, with a proven ability to isolate execution bottlenecks across multi-layered distributed query graphs. Excellent collaborative and communication skills, with a track record of creating clear schema documentation and establishing smooth developer workflows between teams. The business designs and supplies mine winder systems, MV/LV AC drives, DC drives, motors, transformers, resistors, cranes, conveyors, hoisting equipment and custom drive packages. The team operates in a niche, high‑performance environment with strong technical expertise and consistent growth. Role Overview The Software Developer plays a critical role in building the control, automation and simulation software that enables engineered drive systems to operate safely, smoothly and reliably. This role sits at the intersection of industrial automation, electrical engineering, safety systems and 3D simulation, and is ideal for a developer with a strong interest in combining software development with real‑world engineering applications. Collaborate with engineers to integrate software with MV/LV drives, motors, sensors and instrumentation. 3D Simulation & Visualisation Develop 3D simulation environments and interactive training modules using Unity or similar engines. Create realistic operational scenarios to simulate equipment behaviour, safety procedures and fault conditions. Build visual tools that help engineers validate designs and assist clients in understanding system operation. HMI & Interface Development Design and implement Human‑Machine Interfaces (HMIs) for operators, displaying real‑time system status, diagnostics, alarms and performance data. Ensure interfaces are intuitive, reliable and aligned with operational requirements. System Integration & Testing Work closely with electrical and mechanical engineers to ensure seamless integration between software and physical systems. Support testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of control software. Validate safety sequences, operational logic and system behaviour under simulated and real conditions. Technical Collaboration Participate in multidisciplinary engineering projects. Provide input on system architecture, software design and technical problem‑solving. Contribute to continuous improvement of simulation tools, control logic and development processes. Minimum Requirements Degree or Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field. Strong experience with C#, Unity, or similar 3D/game engines. Experience developing software for simulation, training environments or interactive 3D applications. Solid understanding of software architecture, object‑oriented programming and system design. Ability to work with multidisciplinary engineering teams. The Software Developer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining features across the full technology stack of our web platform. The role works across the React/TypeScript frontend, the Node.js/Express backend, and the PostgreSQL database layer, taking ownership of features from specification through to production deployment. Having grown beyond junior responsibilities, this role is expected to deliver production-ready features independently, contribute to technical decisions, handle deployments through our CI/CD pipeline, and integrate the platform with third-party services such as PayFast and transactional email providers. Duties & Responsibilities Minimum requirements (Advantageous): Qualifications Bachelor's Degree (BSc) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field. Experience Minimum 8 years of professional software development experience. Demonstrated experience building and maintaining production web applications across the full stack. Proven track record of shipping features from specification through to deployment. Experience working in a Git-based collaborative development environment. Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web development frameworks and tools, including React 18, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Vite, React Router, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, Framer Motion, and Leaflet. Experience developing secure REST APIs, authentication, file uploads, transactional email, payment gateway integrations, and web application security best practices. Understanding of REST API design principles and HTTP fundamentals. Experience working with Git workflows, including feature branches, pull requests, and code reviews. Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Ability to work independently and take ownership of features from concept through deployment. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical trade-offs effectively. Collaborative mindset with experience participating in code reviews. Self-motivated learner who keeps up to date with modern JavaScript, React, and Node.js development practices. Reliable, accountable, and proactive in identifying and communicating blockers or risks early. Duties and responsibilities include, but not limited to: Translate product requirements, specifications, wireframes, and UI/UX designs into high-quality, production-ready frontend features. Design, build, and maintain modern web applications using React and TypeScript. Develop reusable, maintainable, and well-structured components that can be shared across features and applications. Build responsive, accessible, and intuitive user interfaces that work consistently across modern desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers. Convert UI/UX designs into accurate, polished interfaces while maintaining a consistent visual language across the product. Implement appropriate application architecture, component composition, state management, routing, data fetching, caching, and form-management patterns. Build complex forms and user workflows, including validation, conditional behaviour, multi-step processes, error handling, and user feedback. Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and services, including authentication, file uploads, payments, mapping, notifications, and other third-party services. Work with REST APIs and other service interfaces, correctly handling authentication, pagination, validation errors, loading states, retries, failures, and asynchronous operations. Implement secure authentication and authorisation flows in conjunction with backend services, ensuring appropriate handling of sessions, permissions, and protected application areas. Apply frontend security best practices, including input handling, dependency management, secure browser storage practices, and protection against common web application vulnerabilities. Design frontend solutions that accommodate changing requirements and future functionality without unnecessary complexity or excessive coupling. Optimise applications for performance, including rendering efficiency, network usage, application loading time, asset optimisation, and perceived user responsiveness. Implement appropriate client-side error handling and provide clear, useful feedback when operations fail. Integrate file and image upload functionality, including validation, progress indication, previews, and error handling where required. Implement interactive functionality such as maps, dashboards, data visualisations, search, filtering, dynamic forms, and other rich application experiences as required by the product. Work closely with backend engineers to define and refine API contracts, data structures, authentication flows, and integration requirements. Collaborate with product owners, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and identify practical technical solutions. Participate in technical discussions and contribute to decisions regarding frontend architecture, application structure, reusable components, and engineering standards. Write clean, readable, maintainable, and appropriately documented TypeScript and React code. Write and maintain appropriate automated tests for components, application logic, integrations, and critical user journeys. Diagnose and resolve defects reported by users, internal stakeholders, automated testing, or application monitoring. Investigate and resolve browser-specific, device-specific, performance, usability, and accessibility issues. Refactor and improve existing frontend code to reduce technical debt, improve maintainability, and simplify future development. Review code contributed by other developers and provide constructive feedback on correctness, maintainability, usability, security, and overall engineering quality. Participate in source-control and code-review processes, including producing meaningful commits, pull requests, and supporting technical documentation. Work effectively within automated build, testing, deployment, and CI/CD processes and assist in diagnosing issues affecting frontend releases. Ensure frontend applications are configurable across local, development, staging, and production environments without embedding environment-specific configuration in application code. Maintain awareness of modern React and TypeScript development practices and recommend improvements where they provide clear technical or product value. Take ownership of assigned features from initial requirements through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Contribute to the continued improvement of frontend engineering standards, development practices, tooling, and overall product quality.
